cause.primary: The non-reaping sampler started a process-tree inventory while the root was live, the root exited normally, and the sole waiter recorded or was about to record terminal/reap. The Issue 53 eligibility rule admitted only macOS root task-info ESRCH, so Linux group-membership ESRCH and macOS BSD-identity ESRCH were classified as controller invalidity even when the same root handle closed normally within 1-16 ms.
cause.secondary: The macOS controller-abort kill raced the already completed process and returned EPERM after the primary invalidity. It did not cause the first sampling error or the cohort disposition.
cause.not_candidate_owned: All 12 candidate payloads supported the route, all 216 RHS observations completed, and the defect was reproduced with synthetic helpers at zero candidate, backend, factor, and solve calls.

captured_evidence.reuse_blocker: The captured adapter failures did not record subject_pid, so they cannot prove that the disappearing process was the root owned by the sole waiter.

diagnostic_boundary.name: root-bound same-handle terminal closure
benign_only_when: subject_pid exactly equals the launched root_pid
the adapter phase is an enumerated native process-tree inventory phase
the sole waiter records terminal for the same invocation handle
terminal is no earlier than sample start and no later than 1000 ms after adapter failure
the incomplete sample contributes no sample, error, or maximum-thread value
must_remain_nonpassing: terminal later than the 1000 ms reconciliation window
candidate non-zero exit, timeout, or thread-grant excess after otherwise valid evidence

wayfinder.recommended_successor_title: Freeze a root-bound terminal-closure plan for a fresh refinement witness cohort
